tree.heading: Sea Grant Institution
tree.text: The term “Sea Grant Institution” means a sea grant college or sea grant institute, as those terms are defined in section 1122 of this title.

tree.heading: Tribal organization
tree.text: The term “Tribal organization” has the meaning given the term “tribal organization” in section 5304 of title 25.

tree.heading: Young fisherman
tree.text: The term “young fisherman” means an individual who—

children.text: desires to participate in the commercial fisheries of the United States, including the Great Lakes fisheries;
has worked as a captain, crew member, or deckhand on a commercial fishing vessel for not more than 10 years of cumulative service; or

notes.text: Codification Section was enacted as part of the Young Fishermen’s Development Act, and not as part of titles I and II of Pub. L. 89–454 which comprise this chapter.
